required_approvals.description: The number of default reviewers that must approve a pull request.

reviewers.description: IDs of users to become default reviewers when you create a pull request.

source_matcher.description: id can be either "any" to match all branches, "refs/heads/master" to match certain branch, "pattern" to match multiple branches or "development" to match branching model. type_id must be one of: "ANY_REF", "BRANCH", "PATTERN", "MODEL_BRANCH".

target_matcher.description: id can be either "any" to match all branches, "refs/heads/master" to match certain branch, "pattern" to match multiple branches or "development" to match branching model. type_id must be one of: "ANY_REF", "BRANCH", "PATTERN", "MODEL_BRANCH".
